meta_title: PadelTag - Padel will never be the same
meta_desc: PadelTag is a button you clip to your shirt. Win a point - click it. Your phone counts and says the score out loud.
og_desc: Clip it on. Click to score. Your phone counts and calls the score.
hero_p: No more arguing about the score. Every point goes into your stats: see what works and level up faster. Scoring is free forever.
s1_d: Light and small. You'll forget it's there.
s2_d: Big button. Easy to hit without looking.
s3_d: Hear the score after every point. The match lands in your history by itself.
try_p: Click a PadelTag below and watch the points add up.
mo1_d: One person keeps score. 1 click - us, 2 clicks - them.
p2_d: Each team gets its own button. Whoever wins the point, clicks.
mo4_d: After the match - who scored the most. Bragging rights included.
st_p: Link your tag to your account once. During the match you see your points, after it everything is in your stats: matches, wins, win rate, history.
st_f3: See your points during the match
ex1_d: The phone says the score. No need to look.
ex2_d: The last point goes back. Easy.
ex3_d: Players with an account see the live score on their own phone. Up to 4 phones - one or two on each side of the net.
ex4_d: Both teams click at once? Point doesn't count.
cta_p: Get the button at any store - about $7–14. Scoring is free forever, subscribe when you want to see your progress.
p1_d: Perfect if one person keeps the score. Or add one to your set.
p4_d: A tag for every player. See who scored the most.
fine: App for iPhone. Cancel your subscription anytime in App Store settings.
dl_p: Point your camera at the QR code, or tap your store.
aud1_t: Not sure how to keep score? Your shirt will do it for you.
aud1_pain: You mix up 15-30-40, feel shy to ask and lose focus on the game.
aud1_gain: Click - point, your phone says the score out loud. Golden point and tie-break are counted for you too.
aud2_t: See how you grow - match after match.
aud2_pain: You play often, but don't see progress or know what works.
aud2_gain: Every match in your history: score, partner, opponents, your points. Matches, wins, win rate and points - right on the home screen.
aud3_t: Every court's score, live - on one screen.
aud3_pain: Paper sheets, score disputes, copying results by hand.
aud3_gain: Americano and Mexicano: pairs and courts are set up for you, every court's score goes straight into one standings table. Open it by link on any screen.
mo16_d: Americano or Mexicano: hand out the tags - pairs, courts and standings set themselves up.
p16_d: A tag for every player. Scores from all courts in one live table.
hero_p_new: No need to remember 15-30-40: click the button and your phone calls the score. You just play. Scoring is free forever.
hero_p_pro: Every point goes into your stats: wins, win rate, match history. Honest numbers instead of “I think we won” - see what works and level up faster.
hero_p_club: Americano and Mexicano without paper: pairs and courts set themselves up, every court's score lands in a live table - on any screen by link.
pf_note: Everything you need to keep score.
pp_l4: Another match's score on your phone
pm_note: Write to us - we'll price it for your club.
pm_l2: Pairs and courts set themselves up
shop_p: A one-button iTag key finder works - usually $7–14 each. Pick your country and we'll show you a store.
